scope: Offline native slices of the frozen front-top integral pump mount with current M5 joints and the plain underside pump retainer. Physical cleanup, surface finish, fit, axial take-up, load capacity and lifetime remain unqualified.

show_face_support_evidence.scope: The generic show-face check has no selected protected faces in this recipe; its true value does not establish support-free exterior surfaces.

reading.scope: Streamed emitted support paths clipped to the two wing pockets, lower access branches and actual PCB mouths. Z is the emitted layer height; bounds are path endpoints, not a solid bead envelope or a rigid extraction proof. Native body topology and nominal aperture clearance have separate readings.

wing_cleanout_support_reading.full_bead_method: Emitted Z is the top of the layer. Bound each path by an XY disk of radius width/2 and one layer height downward; project into the display plane with localY=(0,sqrt(3)/2,1/2) and normal=(0,-1/2,sqrt(3)/2). Bounds are evaluated at the two PCB-mouth crossing sections.
wing_cleanout_support_reading.result: Both emitted mouth-crossing bead envelopes fit the open 69.3 by 4.96 mm apertures. These section bounds and the native unobstructed-aperture reading establish access from the deep wing lanes into the empty PCB/display opening; they do not establish intact-tree extraction or physical cleanup.

support_body_bounds_scope.meaning: The support-audit bbox_cad_xyz_mm values are source-space raster-cell-centre bounds, not full bead envelopes. Mouth-crossing bead envelopes are separately calculated from the emitted paths, widths and heights.

support_access_groups.removal_access: The unmated rear Y seam and empty inboard funnel/service bay are open before fitting back-top, funnel frame and rods. Detach branches and peel the bed trunks aft. Labelled interfaces 11 and 12 at Z335.41..335.65 are below the head counterbores; intact extraction of large trees through the 9 mm head holes is not claimed.

support_access_groups.removal_access: Open underside and rear rail mouth before front-bottom installation.

support_access_groups.functional_room: Pump loading opening, motor inverses, M3 pilot tips and west fore-valve branch
support_access_groups.removal_access: Detach pump-region branches from below through the empty loading opening and two 37 mm motor bores. The three M3 pilot-tip branches, labelled interfaces 2..4, withdraw downward through the empty shaft and insert mouths before heat-set inserts and screws are fitted. The west fore-valve branch also opens through its empty tray bay before plumbing. Fragment the remaining trunk as needed.

Detach and fragment the deep wing supports, then clear them through the right lower cleanout into the empty PCB/display opening. The actual mouth-crossing beads fit the 69.3 by 4.96 mm port; preserve the supported glass seat and its 3 mm backing.

support_access_groups.functional_room: Common pump/display wiring and cross room
support_access_groups.removal_access: The connected room opens through the one 22 mm rear mouth and upper U and through the empty motor rooms. Detach and fragment the branches before threading wires. No isolated closed pocket was identified.
Empty holder and service-bay openings are accessible before fitting WAGO carriers and wiring.

support_removal_access_reading: Clean the loose front-top before inserting pumps, heat-set inserts, screws, wiring, display, WAGO blocks, valves, tubes, funnel frame or back-top. Detach room branches before withdrawing or fragmenting bed-rooted trunks.

All 29 native support-body IDs have an identified access route. No genuinely closed or geometrically trapped support component was identified by the path-bound, native-aperture and source-opening reading.

Model-rooted bodies and automatic Tree/Default sections are allowed by the project recipe. The 22 bodies with unlabelled contacts retain unknown contact count and buildup; 14 explicit interface islands do not describe all contacts.
Fragments can be removed through the open functional rooms. No claim is made that complete connected trees or their bounding boxes pass intact through one aperture.

This reading establishes geometric access before hardware installation. It does not establish break-off force, residue, bearing finish, physical tool handling, successful cleanup, load capacity or lifetime.
